concept: A hair salon; service menu and stylist booking.

shots.title: Hero still life
shots.prompt: Luxury beauty still life of hair oil and shampoo bottles of original design with argan and camellia oils, on a sculpted stone plinth, soft directional light and long shadows, negative space on one side for a headline.
